visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The frame opens with a close-up of a chocolate ring bread, heavily dusted with white powdered sugar, resting on newspaper-themed baking paper atop a wooden platter. A pair of hands reaches in to gently pull a section apart, revealing a dark, soft, fibrous interior filled with melted chocolate. (2) The scene shifts to a marble countertop where a hand uses a white plastic dough scraper to divide a large mass of dark chocolate dough. Several smaller portions are then rolled between the palms into smooth, round spheres under bright, flat studio lighting. (3) A single piece of dough is rolled into a long teardrop shape on the marble. A textured white rolling pin is used to flatten it into a long strip. A hand sprinkles dark chocolate chips along the length of the strip before carefully rolling it up from the wide end into a croissant-like cylinder. (4) The shaped dough rolls are placed side-by-side into a circular baking tin that features a central hollow metal tube. The hands position the pieces so they are evenly spaced, tucked against a layer of white parchment paper lining the outer rim. (5) A different shaping method is shown where round dough balls are flattened, filled with a dark chocolate paste from a glass container, and pinched shut. These spheres are then arranged in a three-by-three grid inside a square baking pan lined with parchment. (6) After proofing, the dough in the circular tin has expanded significantly. A hand uses a fine-mesh sieve to dust more powdered sugar over the surface of the ring bread, while another hand uses a small glass spray bottle to mist the dough with water before baking. (7) A pair of grey, textured oven mitts pulls the square baking pan out of a dark oven. The finished bread rolls are shown golden-brown and puffed up. Hands tear into the square rolls, showcasing the extreme softness and steam rising from the chocolate-filled interior. (8) The video concludes with a medium shot of a pink-covered book titled '辣媽Shania的秒殺手撕麵包'. The cover features a photograph of a woman holding a similar ring of bread, with various text overlays and promotional graphics.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice exhibiting a friendly, high-arousal professional tone, speaking in Mandarin with clear articulation and a moderate speech rate. The background music features an upbeat acoustic guitar and piano arrangement at approximately 120 BPM, providing a warm and cheerful atmosphere. (2) As the dough is processed, the acoustic signature shifts to include the sharp, percussive 'clack' of a plastic scraper hitting a marble surface. This is followed by a continuous, low-frequency 'rubbing' sound as the dough is rolled by hand, accompanied by rhythmic 'thuds' when pieces are placed down. (3) The sound of a textured rolling pin creates a repeating, low-amplitude 'zipping' noise against the dough. This is punctuated by the delicate, high-frequency 'clinking' of chocolate chips hitting the marble and the soft 'crinkle' of parchment paper being adjusted in the baking tins. (4) A distinct, short-duration 'pssh' sound of a pressurized water sprayer occurs twice, followed by the light, rhythmic 'tapping' of a sieve. The BGM remains constant in volume and tempo, maintaining a consistent energy level beneath the instructional narration and foley-style sound events. (5) The final phase features the metallic 'clatter' of a baking tray being slid onto a cooling rack. A soft, fibrous 'tearing' sound is clearly audible as the bread is pulled apart, accompanied by a concluding promotional statement from the narrator delivered with an authoritative yet welcoming cadence.
